messages:
Alex (customer): Hi team — our integration started failing after yesterday's deploy. Tool calling attempts to our 'fetch' tool return a schema validation error. Example response: `{'error':'tool_call_schema_error','detail':'missing required field url'}`. Happening for many users. thread id: req_0a1b2c
Priya (support): Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the request body you sent (redact tokens)?
Alex (customer): Sure, sending minimal repro. curl:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call' \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4r","input":"Fetch this page","tool_call":{"name":"fetch","arguments":{"method":"GET"}}}'
```
I had expected the runtime to forward to the 'fetch' tool with default url param from our app, but now it errors with the schema message.
Priya (support): Thanks. @Ethan can you take a look? Looks like schema required 'url' now.
Ethan (eng): On it. Do we have a correlated request id or full error from the API gateway logs? Priya can you attach the API response header 'x-rw-request-id' if present?
Priya (support): Sent user-provided header x-rw-request-id = req_0a1b2c. I also pulled a snippet from our logs: ``[2026-03-16T12:05:43Z] req_0a1b2c ERROR tool_call_handler validation failed: missing field 'url' in arguments for tool 'fetch'``
Ethan (eng): Hmm, we rolled in a stricter tool schema validator in the runtime yesterday to prevent ambiguous arg typing. It looks like customer code relied on implicit defaults populated by the connector layer. CI passed though. @Noah can you run the tool-calling eval suite with the golden prompts that exercise implicit defaults?
Noah (qa): Running locally now. Kicking off `make test-evals --filter=toolcall_defaults` — will paste failing output.
ci-bot: Build 4921 started for branch release/staging (eval suite)
Noah (qa): Local run results:
```
FAIL test_toolcall_defaults.py::test_fetch_infers_url
  Expected tool call args to include 'url' populated from context, got: {'method':'GET'}
  AssertionError: implicit url inference broke after change
```
Noah (qa): CI shows same failure on staging: `toolcall_schema_strictness_test` failing 5/5 Golden prompts mismatched. Looks like the stricter validation rejects missing fields instead of letting the connector fill them.
Ethan (eng): That's consistent. The validator change was intended to catch bad tool contracts, but we missed backward-compat handling for connectors that supply defaults downstream. I'll open a patch to relax validation to allow missing optional fields if a connector policy exists.
Priya (support): For now can we offer a mitigation to customers? e.g., a temporary fallback to pre-validate behavior or a rollout pause?
Ethan (eng): Rolling back is heavy. I can hotfix the validator to check for 'has_connector_defaults' flag on tool metadata and allow missing args for those. Pushing patch now.
ci-bot: Build 4922 queued
Noah (qa): Suggest adding a regression test: golden prompt that previously relied on implicit defaults. Add it to `evals/toolcall/golden_prompts/default_inference.json` and mark it as required in CI.
Ethan (eng): Agree. Adding test and will run in CI. ETA for hotfix 45m.
Alex (customer): Appreciate the quick response. Any ETA for when our traffic will be back to normal? We're hitting 100% failures currently.
Priya (support): We'll route a canary route for your org to the patched validator once build passes — I'll follow up with the rollout id. Also offered credits for the downtime.
Ethan (eng): Patch landed to branch hotfix/toolcall-validator-relax. CI run started.
ci-bot: Build 4922 started
Noah (qa): Running the new regression test locally — passing now. Also added a log assertion to ensure we still warn when args are missing: `WARN tool_call_handler: inferred defaults used for 'fetch'` so we can alert on future changes.
Ethan (eng): CI green on evals: Build 4922 succeeded. Deploying hotfix to staging and canary.
Priya (support): @Alex will you accept a canary invite? We can flip your org to the canary routing for validation.
Alex (customer): Yes please, flipping now. Confirmed requests succeed, no schema errors. Thank you!
Priya (support): Closing the escalation — saving repro and adding regression to mandatory evals. Follow-up: we'll create a postmortem entry and schedule a short doc on connector default semantics to prevent future surprises. :white_check_mark:"
